title: Queue Concepts & BullMQ
definition: Asynchronous job buffer decoupling producers and background workers with reliable delivery guarantees.

keyPoints.title: At-Least-Once Delivery
keyPoints.description: Worker lock heartbeats and acknowledgements ensure tasks are never lost on worker crashes.

keyPoints.title: Retries & Backoff
keyPoints.description: Exponential backoff delays and Dead Letter Queues (DLQ) isolate recurring poison errors.

keyPoints.title: Stalled Job Recovery
keyPoints.description: Automatic watchdog detection reassigns orphaned tasks if a processing worker crashes silently.

recap: BullMQ Redis par banaya gaya Node.js job queue hai jo background task processing ko reliable banata hai. Isme exponential backoff retries, locked job heartbeat renewals, aur stalled job recovery built-in aate hain.

demos.title: Sync HTTP vs async queue
demos.summary: Comparing blocking synchronous execution against non-blocking asynchronous queue buffers.

demos.title: Job lifecycle states
demos.summary: Jobs move atomically through Redis sets: waiting to active with a lock, then completed or failed.

demos.title: Worker locks and stalled jobs
demos.summary: Active jobs require lock heartbeats; on worker crash the lock expires and watchdog triggers duplicate redelivery.

demos.title: Backoff retries and DLQ
demos.summary: Exponential delay backoff isolates thundering herds; exhausted attempts route poison jobs to the DLQ.
